title: Web Browser Navigation
short_description: Implement browser history back-forward stacks, HTML DOM tag validators, and linked-list tab session managers.
real_world_context: Modern web browser engines (such as Chromium, WebKit, and Gecko) power everyday web navigation and interactive communication apps. Browser engines manage session state, tab reordering, historical URL traversal via dual-stack Back/Forward navigation, and structural HTML DOM tree parsing to validate document tag hierarchies.
learning_objectives: Implement dual LIFO stack architectures to manage browser Back and Forward page histories.
Validate nested HTML element tag streams using stack-based syntax parsers.
Manage linear sequences of open browser tabs using Linked List pointer manipulations.
Invert active tab session orders using in-place Reverse Linked List algorithms.
